WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),

record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),

documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),

contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),

sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),

WITH s AS (SELECT %s::bigint dg,%s::bigint cg,%s::bigint[] editions,%s::bigint[] evidence_records),
editions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_seasons" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id=ANY(s.editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
matches AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."matches" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
sides AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
squad AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
engagements AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competition_teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id IN (SELECT id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),

scores AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."match_scores" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
shots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."shots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),

coverage AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."match_coverage" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.feature_code='shots' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical),
minutes AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches) AND r.metric_code='legacy_normalized_minutes' AND r.period_code='full_match') AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_ids AS (SELECT team_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT team_id FROM engagements UNION SELECT team_id FROM shots),
player_ids AS (SELECT player_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT player_id FROM shots),
competitions AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."competitions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
teams AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."teams" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND TRUE),
players AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."players" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND TRUE),
aliases AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."public_aliases" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.route_kind='competition' AND r.competition_id IN (SELECT competition_id FROM editions)) OR (r.route_kind='match' AND r.match_id IN (SELECT id FROM matches)) OR (r.route_kind='team' AND r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) OR (r.route_kind='player' AND r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT r.is_deleted),
team_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."team_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.team_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
player_profiles AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."player_profile_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_ids)) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.cg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.cg<r.recorded_to_gen) AND r.is_canonical AND NOT r.is_deleted),
periods AS (SELECT r.* FROM "football"."periods" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots x WHERE (x.period_code,x.period_definition_version)=(r.code,r.definition_version))) AND r.recorded_from_gen<=s.dg AND (r.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.dg<r.recorded_to_gen)),
record_ids AS (SELECT source_record_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_record_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT unnest(evidence_records) FROM s),
records AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_records" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT id FROM record_ids)) AND TRUE),
documents AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_documents" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT document_id FROM records UNION SELECT document_id FROM coverage)) AND TRUE),
datasets AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."source_datasets" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM documents)) AND TRUE),
sources AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."sources" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.id IN (SELECT source_id id FROM editions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM matches UNION SELECT source_id id FROM sides UNION SELECT source_id id FROM squad UNION SELECT source_id id FROM scores UNION SELECT source_id id FROM shots UNION SELECT source_id id FROM engagements UNION SELECT source_id id FROM coverage UNION SELECT source_id id FROM minutes UNION SELECT source_id id FROM competitions UNION SELECT source_id id FROM aliases UNION SELECT source_id id FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT source_id id FROM periods UNION SELECT source_id id FROM records UNION SELECT source_id id FROM documents UNION SELECT source_id id FROM datasets)) AND TRUE),
contracts AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."relation_contracts" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE ((r.relation_code,r.contract_version) IN (SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM editions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM matches UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM sides UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM squad UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM scores UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM shots UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM engagements UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM coverage UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM minutes UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM competitions UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM aliases UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM team_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM player_profiles UNION SELECT relation_code,contract_version FROM periods) OR r.relation_code='analytics.publication_versions') AND TRUE),
snapshots AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dataset_snapshots" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
journal AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."schema_migrations" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE),
dirty AS (SELECT r.* FROM "ingest"."dirty_editions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
builds AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."aggregation_builds" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions)) AND TRUE),
pointers AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."publication_versions" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.competition_season_id=ANY(s.editions) AND r.published_to_gen IS NULL) AND TRUE),
match_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."match_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
edition_outputs AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."competition_summary" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (r.build_id IN (SELECT id FROM builds)) AND TRUE),
catalogue_pointer AS (SELECT r.* FROM "analytics"."catalog_publication" r CROSS JOIN s WHERE (TRUE) AND TRUE)
